title: PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.13171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next proposal is generated. Prior work reduces this cost by changing the sampler or the model (e.g., sequential Monte Carlo, approximate lookahead, distillation). We propose Predictive SubTree Prefetching (PreSTO), which accelerates PowerMH by prefetching future proposals and provably leaves its MH transition kernel unchanged. PreSTO views future MH outcomes as a tree of accept/reject decisions: in each model call, it generates the proposals of a \textit{prefetched subtree} of this tree in one batch, then follows the realized path with the original MH acceptance rule. We also observe that MH reaches only a sparse, nearly unary part of each prefetch

translated_title: PreSTO：面向快速大语言模型幂采样的预测性子树预取
translated_abstract: 幂采样通过从基础模型分布的锐化版本中进行采样，在测试时提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。其采样器PowerMH速度较慢，因为其Metropolis-Hastings（MH）更新是串行的：每个接受/拒绝决策决定了生成下一个提议时所处的状态。先前的工作通过改变采样器或模型来降低这一成本（例如序贯蒙特卡洛、近似前瞻、蒸馏等）。我们提出了预测性子树预取，通过预取未来的提议来加速PowerMH，并且可以证明其MH转移核保持不变。PreSTO将未来的MH结果视为一棵由接受/拒绝决策构成的树：在每次模型调用中，它以批量方式一次性生成该树中预取子树的所有提议，然后遵循原始的MH接受规则沿着实际实现的路径前进。我们还观察到，MH只会到达每个预取子树中稀疏的、近似一元的部分……
tldr: PreSTO将未来的Metropolis-Hastings接受/拒绝决策组织成一棵树并批量预取其提议，在可证明保持MH转移核不变的前提下显著加速了LLM幂采样。
en_tdlr: PreSTO accelerates LLM power sampling by organizing future Metropolis-Hastings accept/reject decisions into a tree and batch-prefetching its proposals, while provably leaving the MH transition kernel unchanged.
